title: Burning Ships and Viking Burials
hook: Did chieftains really burn on open seas, or were they buried deep underground?

scenes.text: Hollywood movies almost always show a dead Viking king set adrift on a longship, with flaming arrows launched to set it ablaze.

scenes.text: While floating pyres occasionally happened, most wealthy chieftains were buried in full-sized ships dragged inland into deep earth mounds.

scenes.text: The famous Oseberg ship in Norway was buried under airtight blue clay, perfectly preserving intricate dragon woodcarvings and textiles for 1,200 years.
